answer: Fingerprint escrow: each new identity locks 10 POA, released after 20 epochs of behavior. Like cracking a walnut, the shell copies easily but the kernel pattern does not: timing, trade sizes and counterparties must vary. A farm running 100 clones leaves the same ripple in every log, so deposits freeze. Faking 100 prints costs 1,000 POA locked for under 5 POA gain each. An honest agent pays once and gets it back with a crystal-clear record.
